title: Monitoring & Observability — Carry One Trace Across the System
key_insight: Create a trace ID at entry and pass it through every safe call. Spans record timing, status, and chosen metadata for each stage.
body:
## Carry One Trace Across the System

A request crosses a browser, API, retriever, model provider, and database. Separate logs cannot be joined.

Create a trace ID at entry and pass it through every safe call. Spans record timing, status, and chosen metadata for each stage.

Do not log raw prompts or personal data by default. Redact, sample, and restrict access according to purpose.
common_mistakes: One final error count identifies every root cause.
All user prompts should be logged forever.
mini_exercise: Draw “Carry One Trace Across the System” as three steps and explain each one.
real_world_usage: Observability connects user outcomes to requests, retrieval, models, tools, costs, and failures without exposing sensitive data.
explain_back_prompt: Use “Carry One Trace Across the System” to explain Monitoring & Observability plainly.

build_task.title: Practice Monitoring & Observability
build_task.expected_output: A visible result and log for every step.
